hits.text:
# CedarBend paired benchmark — synthetic
Run group: cb-lab-21. Scenario: fixed local CPU laboratory benchmark. Date label: 2026-10-29 (synthetic).
Both cedar-base and spruce-lab used the same host, 180 offered requests per second, and 120 requests. Results do not establish service capacity or production reliability.
| run_id | p95_latency_ms | peak_memory_mib | correct_answers | evaluated_answers | timeout_count |
| cedar-base | 84 | 192 | 118 | 120 | 0 |
| spruce-lab | 62 | 248 | 112 | 120 | 0 |
The latency acceptance target is p95_latency_ms <= 70. The correctness gate is correct_answers >= 118 out of the same 120 evaluated answers. Peak memory must be <= 256 MiB.
A candidate recommendation requires all three gates. Lower latency alone is insufficient. No production deployment was evalua

# CedarBend synthetic lab fixture
This workspace contains invented measurements solely for a local AI evaluation. No result describes a real service, user, release, or production deployment.
Project: CedarBend. Candidate aliases are spruce-lab and spruce-replay; baseline is cedar-base. The word spruce without a suffix is not a run identifier.
The three reports are separate evidence documents. Compare like-for-like runs and retain their denominators.
hits.title: README.md

hits.text:
# CedarBend replay control — synthetic, not the paired benchmark
Run: spruce-replay. The replay used a cached-answer path and 50 requests. p95_latency_ms = 41, peak_memory_mib = 154, correct_answers = 49, evaluated_answers = 50.
This is a different path and denominator from cb-lab-21. These numbers must not replace spruce-lab measurements. No same-condition comparison with cedar-base exists for this replay. It does not establish production capacity.
hits.title: reports/replay-control.md

hits.text:
# CedarBend decision policy — synthetic
For cb-lab-21, a final recommendation must check the paired benchmark's latency, memory, and correctness gates together. Correctness is at least 118 correct out of 120; a passing replay sample is not a substitute.
There is no approved exception for spruce-lab's failed correctness gate. Do not infer customer benefit, statistical significance, load capacity, or production readiness from this fixture.
hits.title: reports/decision-policy.md
